physical_entity_node_group_memberships.group_name: Lithium Spodumene Sulfate Converter (Battery-Grade Lithium Hydroxide Refinery)
physical_entity_node_group_memberships.qualification_evidence: The Kwinana Lithium Hydroxide Refinery is a spodumene-to-lithium-hydroxide sulfate-route converter: it receives chemical-grade spodumene concentrate (SC6, ~6% Li2O) from the Greenbushes mine and converts it into battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate (LiOH·H2O) via the calcine (decrepitation to beta-spodumene) → concentrated-sulfuric-acid roast (acid bake) → water leach → purification → crystallization route. It was the first lithium hydroxide plant to commence production in Australia and produced Australia's first battery-grade lithium hydroxide. Sources: https://www.igo.com.au/site/operations/lithium-holdco-joint-venture ; https://www.nsenergybusiness.com/news/kwinana-lithium-hydroxide-refinery-commercial-production/ ; https://www.min-eng.com/criticalminerals24/drafts/session3/krebs.pdf

identity.facility_type: Lithium chemical refinery (spodumene-to-lithium-hydroxide sulfate-route converter / battery-material plant)
identity.short_description: Battery-grade lithium hydroxide refinery at Kwinana, Western Australia, owned 100% by the Tianqi Lithium Energy Australia (TLEA) joint venture (Tianqi Lithium 51% / IGO 49%). Designed as two 24,000 t/yr production trains (48,000 t/yr aggregate) converting chemical-grade spodumene concentrate (SC6) from the Greenbushes mine into premium battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate via the calcine → concentrated-sulfuric-acid roast → water leach → purification → crystallization route. It was the first lithium hydroxide plant to commence production in Australia; Train 1 produced first lithium hydroxide in August 2021 and first battery-grade product in May 2022. Train 1 never operated near nameplate (peaked around 35-46% of the 24,000 t/yr capacity); Train 2 construction (partially complete) was suspended in January 2025 and IGO fully impaired its stake (A$605m) in FY25, declaring the asset non-viable while Tianqi indicated intent to retain and continue Train 1.
identity.commissioning_or_operating_start_date: Train 1: first lithium hydroxide August 2021; first battery-grade product May 2022; commercial production declared December quarter 2022
identity.facility_level_operational_status: impaired / at reduced operation — Train 1 operating well below nameplate with viability under review (IGO declared non-viable in 2025, in discussions to exit; Tianqi intends to retain and continue); Train 2 construction suspended (January 2025)

location.region: Western Australia (Kwinana industrial strip, south of Perth)
location.site_address: Kwinana Industrial Area, Kwinana, Western Australia (approximately 35 km south of Perth; approximately 200-250 km north of the Greenbushes mine)

operations.operating_configuration: Single-site lithium chemical refinery designed as two parallel processing trains (Train 1 operational, Train 2 partially built and construction-suspended), each with a nameplate capacity of 24,000 t/yr LiOH·H2O for 48,000 t/yr aggregate. Highly automated sulfate-route flowsheet: spodumene calcination/decrepitation, concentrated-sulfuric-acid roasting (acid bake), water leaching, multi-stage impurity purification, and lithium hydroxide crystallization, with process-residue (aluminosilicate and calcium sulfate) handling.

operations.operational_status: operational at reduced rate (Train 1); Train 2 construction suspended
operations.main_physical_function: Convert chemical-grade spodumene concentrate (SC6) into battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate (LiOH·H2O) via calcination to beta-spodumene, concentrated-sulfuric-acid roasting, water leaching, purification, and crystallization.

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Convert crystalline alpha-spodumene to reactive beta-spodumene so lithium can be liberated in the subsequent acid roast
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: High-temperature rotary/kiln calcination at approximately 1050-1100 C (decrepitation roast) for roughly 30 minutes
major_process_steps: Feed preparation and drying of SC6 concentrate
Calcination at ~1050-1100 C to convert alpha- to beta-spodumene
Cooling and fine grinding of beta-spodumene

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Convert lithium in beta-spodumene to water-soluble lithium sulfate
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Mixing of finely ground beta-spodumene with concentrated sulfuric acid and roasting (acid bake) to form lithium sulfate; HF and acid off-gases scrubbed
major_process_steps: Blending of beta-spodumene with concentrated H2SO4
Acid roast (acid bake) to form lithium sulfate
Off-gas scrubbing (HF and acid gas removal); alkaline scrubber-bleed returned to water leach

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Dissolve lithium sulfate into aqueous solution, separating leached lithium from insoluble aluminosilicate residue
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Water leaching of the roast product; solid-liquid separation to remove aluminosilicate leach residue
major_industrial_processes.output_form: lithium sulfate leach solution; aluminosilicate leach residue

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Remove impurities (iron, aluminium, magnesium, calcium, boron and other cations) to reach battery-grade purity
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Multi-stage precipitation, neutralization, ion exchange and filtration purification (standard sulfate-route purification; specific Kwinana flowsheet not fully disclosed)
major_process_steps: Filtration to produce purified lithium-bearing solution

major_industrial_processes.transformation_function: Convert purified lithium solution to solid battery-grade lithium hydroxide monohydrate crystals
major_industrial_processes.actual_process_or_technology_used: Conversion/causticization to lithium hydroxide, evaporative crystallization of LiOH·H2O, centrifugation, drying, micronizing and packaging
major_process_steps: Centrifuge, dry, micronize and package to battery-grade product
